sources.title: Instructor note: canonical request hashing
sources.content: Canonical serialization sorts object keys and normalizes supported values. Equivalent objects therefore produce the same serialized bytes and the same SHA-256 request key.

sources.title: Instructor note: recorded replay
sources.content: A frozen replay performs no provider or network generation. It verifies the retained artifact checksums and reuses the accepted bytes. A seed alone is not evidence that a hosted generation will repeat.
